thesis: The homepage is a consumer-magazine exposé that a locksmith wrote about its own trade: every price and promise is footnoted to its sample source, and the editor's red pen strikes out the bait quote and writes the real range in the margin.

signature.name: Red-Pen Errata + Margin Footnotes
signature.summary: One editor's correction system: a red proofreader strike (SVG line drawn left-to-right via --sw-p) through the 'bait' figure or phrase, a red caret with the corrected value set in IBM Plex Mono, and a numbered superscript that pins a margin note (sample source) in a 3-col sidenote column. Hero cover: '$19' struck, '$85-$165 sample range' written in; bait story: the growing quote is struck and corrected on scroll; proof: reviews are footnoted pull-quotes, footnote numbers link to their margin source; price back cover: each row carries a red tick and footnote; checklist pull-out: answers get red tick or red cross; footer colophon collects every footnote as the errata list.

palette.family: Newsprint + Press Black + Correction Red + Highlighter Brass

layoutMoves: 12-col article grid with a 3-col margin/sidenote column on the right that carries every footnote (inline expand under 900px)
running folio header per section ('p. 04 — What a lockout costs') + cover table of contents as nav
pull-out checklist page: perforated dashed edge, kraft mid tone, -0.6deg tilt on desktop only
back-cover price card on deep, full-bleed, set as a typeset price table in mono

motion.intro: Print run, 1.0s total: masthead clips in from top 0-300ms, cover photo unclips upward 200-700ms, cover lines type in mono 60ms stagger, red strike draws through '$19' at 800ms; skippable by any scroll/key, content in DOM from first paint.
stories: Bait-and-switch (pinned >=900px, 3 steps, 220svh): a phone quote '$19' grows digit by digit into a door bill '$300+' (count), then the red pen draws a strike through it and writes the sample range $85-$165 in the margin (draw).
motion.hover: Red proofreader underline grows scaleX 0->1 from left, 200ms, on links, cover lines and cards.
